coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Pier 70 Parcel B
record.summary: Large commercial-office parcel on 20th Street at the waterfront, next to the ship-repair yard; 90 ft / six stories under the D4D. It is an option parcel of a later phase (Phase 3B in the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan) and has no design, appraisal or construction record.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- this block is not yet built and does not correspond to any subdivided Assessor parcel: it currently sits on vacant/graded land, surface parking, or an existing industrial building slated for demolition within Brookfield's 28-acre district (unaddressed in DataSF's Assessor roll). Redone 2026-09-14 with a corrected, shear-free transform (see digitization_method) -- treat vertex positions as accurate to roughly 5-15m, not survey-grade. NOTE: this polygon is NOT clipped against real streets or existing buildings -- unlike Potrero's approximate blocks, several of Pier 70's D4D blocks are sited on existing industrial buildings that will be demolished, so overlap with a currently-real building is often expected, not an error; a boundary that appears to touch or slightly cross a street centerline reflects this transform's 1-8m residual error, not a deliberate encroachment.
notes.digitized_from: Pier 70 Design for Development, Figure 6.4.2 - Maximum Building Height (p.155).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: A real Assessor parcel may exist under this block (part of Brookfield's larger, largely unaddressed 28-acre site), but it has not been subdivided per the masterplan's individual named parcels -- this uses hand-traced approximate geometry instead.
notes.regulatory_context: Office (not residential/mixed-use, per Brookfield's own leasing brochure), 90 ft max per Figure 6.4.2 (6-story cap per D4D Section 6.4.2, not the sometimes-cited '6-8 stories'). ~500,000 RSF, Phase 3. No construction-start source found.

open_questions: No construction start, building permit or vertical DDA for this parcel was found in any Port Commission document through the August 11, 2026 informational report, which says the developer 'has not exercised an option of any Phase 1 option parcels'.

Per-parcel gross square footage and unit counts are not published in the D4D (which sets height, stories and land-use scenarios, not parcel programs); the SUD's per-parcel programs would be in the SUD ordinance (Planning Code Sec. 249.79) or the Phase Submittal, neither of which was retrieved.

Brookfield's leasing brochure reportedly lists Parcel B at about 500,000 RSF (recorded in this parcel's geometry file); the brochure could not be retrieved in this pass (pier70sf.com/leasing shows only project-wide totals of 1.82M RSF new office and 250,000 RSF historic rehab), so no square footage is stated here.
The 2017 DDA terms tie the Arts Building start to completion of 'the office building on Parcel B-2'; whether 'B-2' is a sub-parcel of B is not explained in the retrieved text.
